title: Glowing sunflower
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE566' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFCC00' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF9900' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB300'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='centerGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B5E00'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5C3A00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3D2500'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='40' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='60' width='8' height='38' rx='3' fill='#3A8C2A'/>
  <rect x='48' y='60' width='2' height='38' fill='#5CB84A'/>

  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='78' rx='14' ry='6' transform='rotate(-25 36 78)' fill='#4CAF3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='78' rx='10' ry='3' transform='rotate(-25 36 78)' fill='#6FD65E'/>

  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='13' ry='5.5' transform='rotate(20 64 88)' fill='#4CAF3D'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='9' ry='2.8' transform='rotate(20 64 88)' fill='#6FD65E'/>

  <!-- Petals - outer ring -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='12' rx='7' ry='12' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='7' ry='12' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='20' cy='42' rx='12' ry='7' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='42' rx='12' ry='7' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='29' cy='21' rx='7' ry='11' transform='rotate(-45 29 21)' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='71' cy='21' rx='7' ry='11' transform='rotate(45 71 21)' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='29' cy='63' rx='7' ry='11' transform='rotate(45 29 63)' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
    <ellipse cx='71' cy='63' rx='7' ry='11' transform='rotate(-45 71 63)' fill='url(#petalGrad)'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Petals - inner ring (lighter, smaller) -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='18' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='42' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='42' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='26' rx='6' ry='9' transform='rotate(-45 34 26)' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='26' rx='6' ry='9' transform='rotate(45 66 26)' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='58' rx='6' ry='9' transform='rotate(45 34 58)' fill='#FFD633'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='58' rx='6' ry='9' transform='rotate(-45 66 58)' fill='#FFD633'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Center disc -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='16' fill='url(#centerGrad)'/>

  <!-- Center seed pattern - lit dots -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='12' fill='#6B4200'/>
  <g fill='#A86E00'>
    <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='36' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='46' cy='48' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='48' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='51' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='46' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='46' r='1.2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bright center highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='5' fill='#D49400' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Tiny glowing sparkles -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#FFF7AA'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#FFF7AA'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='16' r='1.2' fill='#FFF7AA'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='1.2' fill='#FFF7AA'/>
</svg>
